name: JW Marriott Atlanta Buckhead
positioning: JW Marriott hotel in Atlanta's Buckhead neighborhood, connected to Lenox Square shopping by a private entrance, with a design inspired by the site's history as the Joyeuse estate
best_for: Shoppers who want direct access to Lenox Square
Travelers who want a Buckhead base near the MARTA train
Families wanting connected rooms with two bathrooms

facts.text: The hotel is in Atlanta's upscale Buckhead neighborhood.
The hotel connects directly to the shopping at Lenox Square through a private entrance.
The Lenox Square MARTA train stop is about half a block from the hotel, giving easy access to Atlanta's sights.
The hotel is close to the LEGO Discovery Center and to shopping at Phipps Plaza.
Rooms have entertainment systems and marble bathrooms.
PURE rooms are equipped with a 4-in-1 true HEPA air purifier for an allergy-friendly stay.
Family connector rooms feature two rooms, two bathrooms, two TVs and multiple beds.
The hotel has an indoor pool and a fitness center.
The fitness center is open 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
The Preserve restaurant and bar serves locally inspired menus with signature homemade preserves.
JW Market serves Starbucks coffee, breakfast, lunch sandwiches, snacks and pastries.

highlights.text: The hotel's design celebrates the site's history as an equestrian estate and a stately southern manor named Joyeuse.
Some rooms have sweeping views of downtown Atlanta.
The Executive Concierge Lounge has skyline views and food and beverage amenities, for Elite Marriott Bonvoy members and guests on the Concierge Floors.

considerations.text: Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport is about 18 miles from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
